name: blank-heavy-repeats
description: A checklist with 24 identical '- TODO' lines separated by blank lines. The task edits only the 15th and 24th occurrences. Probes disambiguation of heavy repeated context, blank-line handling, and one-line-per-item discipline in newLines.
prompt: Edit checklist.md using ONLY the read and edit tools. The file has 24 identical '- TODO' lines. Change ONLY the 15th '- TODO' (in Stage 4) to '- TODO (blocked on design review)' and ONLY the 24th (the last one, in Stage 6) to '- TODO (final signoff)'. Every other '- TODO' must stay exactly as it is. Do not use any other tool.
